sentences.en: How are you getting on with your art project, Tom?
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 你的艺术项目进展如何，汤姆？

sentences.en: OK
sentences.zh: MAN: 好的。

sentences.en: Like, they gave us the theme of birds to base our project on, and I'm not really all that interested in wildlife
sentences.zh: MAN: 比如，他们给了我们‘鸟类’这个主题作为项目基础，而我对野生动物其实并不太感兴趣。

sentences.en: But I'm starting to get into it
sentences.zh: MAN: 但我渐渐开始投入进去了。

sentences.en: I've pretty well finished the introductory stage
sentences.zh: MAN: 我差不多已完成介绍性阶段了。

sentences.en: So have I
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 我也是。

sentences.en: When they gave us all those handouts with details of books and websites to look at
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 就是他们发给我们那些印有参考书目和网站详情的资料时。

sentences.en: I was really put off, but the more I read, the more interested l got
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 我当时真的提不起兴趣，但读得越多，我就越感兴趣。

sentences.en: Me too
sentences.zh: MAN: 我也是。

sentences.en: I found I could research so many different aspects of birds in art- colour
sentences.zh: MAN: 我发现可以从艺术角度研究鸟类的诸多不同方面——比如色彩。

sentences.en: movement, texture
sentences.zh: MAN: 动态、质感。

sentences.en: So I was looking forward to the Bird Park visit
sentences.zh: MAN: 所以我原本很期待去鸟类公园参观。

sentences.en: What a letdown!
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 太令人失望了！

sentences.en: It poured with rain and we hardly saw a single bird
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 那天下着倾盆大雨，我们几乎一只鸟都没看见。

sentences.en: Much less Q21IQ22 use than the trip to the Natural History Museum
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 更别说（对Q21和Q22）的实际应用价值了，远不如去自然历史博物馆那次参观。

sentences.en: Yeah
sentences.zh: MAN: 是啊。

sentences.en: I liked all the stuff about evolution there
sentences.zh: MAN: 我很喜欢那里关于进化论的全部内容。

sentences.en: The workshop sessions with Dr Fletcher were good too, especially the brainstorming sessions
sentences.zh: MAN: 和弗莱彻博士一起的工作坊也很棒，尤其是头脑风暴环节。

sentences.en: I missed those because I was ill
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 我因为生病错过了那些活动。

sentences.en: I wish we could've seen the projects last year's students did
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 我真希望能看看去年学生们做的项目。

sentences.en: Mm
sentences.zh: MAN: 嗯。

sentences.en: I suppose they want us to do our own thing, not copy
sentences.zh: MAN: 我想他们是希望我们独立创作，而不是照搬模仿。

sentences.en: Have you drafted your proposal yet?
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 你已经起草好提案了吗？

sentences.en: Yes, but I haven't handed it in
sentences.zh: MAN: 起草好了，但还没提交。

sentences.en: I need to amend some parts
sentences.zh: MAN: 我还需要修改其中一些部分。

sentences.en: I've realised the notes from my research are almost all just descriptions, l haven't actually evaluated anything
sentences.zh: MAN: 我意识到自己研究笔记几乎全是描述性内容，实际上并未对任何内容进行评估。

sentences.en: So I'll have to fix that
sentences.zh: MAN: 所以我得把这个问题解决掉。

sentences.en: Oh, I didn't know we had to do that
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 哦，我不知道我们还得做这个。

sentences.en: I'll have to look at that too
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 我也得去查看一下这方面要求。

sentences.en: Did you do a timeline for the project?
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 你为这个项目制定时间表了吗？

sentences.en: Yes, and a mind map
sentences.zh: MAN: 制定了，还做了思维导图。

sentences.en: Yeah, so did 1.1 quite enjoyed that
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 是啊，我也做了，还挺喜欢这个过程的。

sentences.en: But it was hard having to explain the basis for my decisions in my action plan
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 但要在行动方案中解释自己各项决策的依据，这确实很难。
